channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker

item.title: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship
item.description: After a Supreme Court ruling against it, the Trump administration had tried a narrower set of restrictions.

item.title: Two Italians killed by ‘drone strike debris’ in Kuwait
item.description: Iran has strongly denied any involvement in the fatal incident.

item.title: Two dead after Iranian drone attack on Kuwait
item.description: Kuwait’s army says two Italian workers were killed and four others were injured in an Iranian drone attack.

item.title: Can Trump continue with Iran war despite funding restrictions?
item.description: A Congress budget bill could serve as a pressure tactic on Trump to end the war but could also trigger a shutdown.

item.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
item.description: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

item.title: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
item.description: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.

item.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
item.description: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

item.title: Desperate appeals from women on death row in Iran after protests
item.description: Female protesters and dissidents are being sentenced to death in numbers not seen for decades, a rights group says.

item.title: A renovation was meant to improve these Hong Kong homes - it ended in a blaze that killed 168
item.description: A year after one of Hong Kong's deadliest fires, families left behind are still waiting for justice.
